name: GUI-Net-Benchmark
description:
Introduction
	

In our work TongUI, we benchmarked model performance in various testset. As paper indicated, we proposed our agent as ReAct, so it outputs thought and actions.
However, the offline benchmarks we used does not contain thought in the dataset, so we managed to generate thought for them. This repo host those data, and is important to reproduce our results.

	
		
		Note
	


For AITW, Mind2Web, we generated thought for each step
For baidu experience, we carefully annotated… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Bofeee5675/GUI-Net-Benchmark.
reputation: Released alongside the TongUI project to reproduce agent evaluation results; primarily used by the authors and related researchers with limited broader adoption so far.
